## 1. Story and purpose
**As** a customer, **I want** to see the bills I paid, **so that** I can prove a payment.

Objective: fewer support tickets asking for payment receipts.

INVEST check: Independent ✓ · Negotiable ✓ · Valuable ✓ · Estimable ✓ · Small ✓ · Testable ✓

## 2. Use cases
- **Happy path:** 1. Open "Pagos". 2. See paid bills, newest first. 3. Open one to see its receipt.
- **Alternative paths:** filter by service.
- **Contingencies:** dependency unavailable · session expired · server error · duplicate or concurrent action

## 3. Business rules and validations
| # | Rule | Value | Source | Message / error code |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| R-1 | History depth | [TBD: months shown] | brief | — |

Permissions and roles: account owner only.
Traceability: none.

## 4. Acceptance criteria
- **AC-1** — Given I paid 2 bills, when I open "Pagos", then I see 2 rows, newest first.
- **AC-2 (edge)** — Given I paid nothing, when I open "Pagos", then I see "Aún no tienes pagos".
- **NFR-1** — The first page loads in under 1 s at p95.

## 8. Security and privacy
- Personal data: sensitive (financial) → show the last 4 digits of the reference.
- Never logged: payment references.
- Re-authentication / confirmation before: N/A — read only.
- Limits and retries: retry unlimited on the list.
- Surface-specific: mobile: no screenshot restriction · web: no user content rendered.

## 9. Out of scope
- Paying a bill from this screen.
